Develop a reusable strategy for identifying the complete set of immediately safe Snake actions. The example illustrates appearance only, not a test state. Use the head arrow to map left, straight and right to adjacent cells. Distinguish walls, non-tail body and the pointed tail; a non-eating move can enter the vacating tail. Classify each action independently as collision or no collision. When all three collide, the safe set is empty. Do not replace these judgements with a preferred move or long-term food pursuit. After your reasoning, return a concise reusable plan.<turn|>
